verified_facts.text: Palmaia sits between the jungle and the ocean on Mexico's Riviera Maya.
verified_facts.excerpt: Palmaïa is a groundbreaking wellness concept nestled between the jungle and the ocean on Mexico’s Riviera Maya

verified_facts.text: Palmaia is located on the most southern point of Playa del Carmen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Palmaïa is located on the most southern point of Playa del Carmen

verified_facts.text: The resort is surrounded by 400 hectares of virgin jungle.
verified_facts.excerpt: surrounded by 400 hectares of virgin jungle

verified_facts.text: Cancun airport is about a 45-minute drive away.
verified_facts.excerpt: Close enough to be an easy 45min drive to Cancun airport

verified_facts.text: There are no roads to Palmaia; guests enter a private residential development and cross a neighbouring resort by golf cart to reach it.
verified_facts.excerpt: There are no roads or streets to Palmaïa, therefore the only way of accessing is through another neighbouring resort. This system allows a double layer of security as you have to enter a private residential development and then cross a resort by golf cart

verified_facts.text: Remnants of Mayan sacred sites still exist on the land, outside of public view.
verified_facts.excerpt: This is a land where remnants of Mayan sacred sites still exist, outside of public view.

verified_facts.text: The resort was deliberately built up rather than out to preserve as much of the land and natural landscape as possible.
verified_facts.excerpt: we made a conscious decision to build our resort up and not out—to preserve as much of the revered land and natural landscape as possible

verified_facts.text: A woven wooden tunnel leads from the rooms to the beach, and elevated walkways wind through the jungle canopy.
verified_facts.excerpt: A meandering woven wooden tunnel is a passageway from your room to the beach, and elevated walkways wind through foliage that forms a protective canopy overhead

verified_facts.text: Pathways lead through the jungle to yoga decks, cenotes and spa treatment temples.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wandering pathways undulate between trees and plants and rocks and lead to quiet yoga decks, tranquil cenotes, and peaceful spa treatment temples.

verified_facts.text: Wildlife on the grounds includes sereques, coatis, spider monkeys, iguanas and armadillos.
verified_facts.excerpt: From Sereques, the lovable rodents who aren’t shy, and Coati with their ring-like tails, to Spider Monkeys, Igauanas and Armadillos

verified_facts.text: All suites are oceanfront.
verified_facts.excerpt: ## 234 Oceanfront Suites

verified_facts.text: All suites are free of animal products.
verified_facts.excerpt: Respecting nature, all suites are free of animal products choosing compassion over violence

verified_facts.text: Palmaia uses a one-rate all-inclusive system where guests pay once.
verified_facts.excerpt: We have a one rate system (all-inclusive) where you pay once and everything is included\*.

verified_facts.text: Spa, private dinners and private one-on-one sessions may carry extra charges.
verified_facts.excerpt: \*Certain services may have extra charges like Spa, Private Dinners, Private 1:1 sessions, boutique, etc.

verified_facts.text: The AiA Wellness program offers more than 50 holistic and health activities every week, led by in-house and visiting guides.
verified_facts.excerpt: More than 50 holistic and health activities carried out every week by our in-house and visiting guides.

verified_facts.text: Atlantis Spa sits among ancient rock formations, jungle, natural cenotes and mangroves.
verified_facts.excerpt: Atlantis Spa emerges as a mystical sanctuary nestled among ancient rock formations, lush jungle, natural cenotes and endemic mangroves.

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments are carried out in temples integrated into the jungle.
verified_facts.excerpt: Treatments are carried out in our beautiful Temples perfectly integrated into the natural surroundings of the Jungle.

verified_facts.text: Indigenous healing at Atlantis Spa is practiced by medicine-men and women whose knowledge has often been passed down through generations.
verified_facts.excerpt: the ancient wisdom of indigenous healing is practiced by skilled medicine-men and women whose knowledge in many cases has been passed down through generations

verified_facts.text: The Nourishing Biome food program removes the most toxic ingredients of the modern food system.
verified_facts.excerpt: Instead of dictating what you should eat, we simplify by removing the most toxic ingredients in the modern food system.

verified_facts.text: There are four themed restaurants.
verified_facts.excerpt: in one of our four themed restaurants that cross the seven seas on a culinary adventure

verified_facts.text: The Rituals of Sound are casual music gatherings built around energy, frequency and sound.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Rituals of Sound create casual gatherings for this purpose, held at beautiful locations where deep beats nourish the soul.

verified_facts.text: The Beach Temple is inspired by ancient solar calendars.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by ancient solar calendars, it resembles ancient astronomical and ceremonial sites.

verified_facts.text: The DEPTH excursion visits the Mayan community of Nuevo Durango and the projects funded by guests' private session bookings.
verified_facts.excerpt: offering the opportunity to visit the community of Nuevo Durango and discover the projects made possible with the profits received from private sessions booked by guests

verified_facts.text: Beginning November 1, 2026, Palmaia welcomes children aged 10 and above.
verified_facts.excerpt: beginning November 1st, 2026, we will welcome children aged 10 years and above

verified_facts.excerpt: Jungle Gym and Fitness Center
